Autoimmune paraneoplastic retinal dysfunction; associated extraocular cancers are separate diseases and do not establish additional organ involvement.
Uncoupled oxidative phosphorylation causes hypermetabolism and biochemical abnormalities; developmental delay in 2/2 supports neurologic involvement. Elevated urea alone is not renal damage.
Defective assembly of gamma-A globulin (IgA) is an immune-protein disorder; no evidence establishes other organ damage.
Isolated congenital duplication of digits on the postaxial side of the hand.
Benign tumor occupying buccal oral mucosa, which belongs to the gastrointestinal axis.
Inherited retinal degeneration with night blindness, visual-field constriction and severely impaired electroretinographic responses.
Aluminum-associated pulmonary interstitial fibrosis with possible bullous emphysema; no additional organ involvement is established.
Inherited predisposition defined by neuroblastoma of sympathetic neural tissue; this primary label identifies the target tissue, without implying an existing tumor or organ damage.
